brief.summary: Barcelona art-school dressing: graphic knits and printed jersey, mid-century colour, soft tailoring and bare, sculptural shapes. Pieces are worn as a mix of artworks — a swirl-print tee under a knitted vest, a mesh top under a slip, a wrap skirt with a chunky sandal — on a relaxed, slightly 70s body.
signatures: graphic print t-shirt or long-sleeve mesh top
knitted vest or cropped patterned cardigan
high-waisted wide-leg trouser in a solid colour
chunky leather sandal or square-toe boot
silhouettes: high waist with a cropped top
